bio.text: Brendan Boyle represents Pennsylvania's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House, to which he was first elected in 2014, and is the Ranking Member of the House Budget Committee.
Before Congress he was elected to the Pennsylvania state legislature in 2008.
Boyle was born and raised in Philadelphia, attended the University of Notre Dame, and earned a master's degree in public policy from Harvard's John F. Kennedy School of Government.
